title: Nvidia surges on strong AI chip demand
body: Nvidia posted record data-center revenue as AI chip demand exceeded forecasts. $NVDA jumped 8%.

title: Retailer warns of weak holiday quarter
body: A major retailer warned of weak consumer spending and cut its full-year guidance, sending shares lower.

title: Boeing wins large aircraft order from Asian carrier
body: Boeing secured an order for 40 widebody jets, a win that boosts its backlog. $BA rose 2% on the news.
